execution_dependency: Execute only if P0-A decision is DYNAMIC_PARTIAL_OVERLAP_REPRESENTATION_SENSITIVITY_SUPPORTED. Reuse the exact P0-A raw-generations.jsonl; no additional model calls or generated samples are allowed.
purpose: Test whether the support-quotient semantic target is operationally realizable on the same faithful Qwen3 source-conditioned candidate bank using only the shared non-novel author-validator rejection backend within the original 72 proposer-call budget.
claim_boundary: P0-B is a local feasibility falsifier, not a downstream utility result and not evidence that rejection sampling is novel. GO permits a later evolution-utility experiment; it does not unlock C3 by itself.

semantic_projection.atom_source: Frozen released API-Bank validator-support audit before Qwen3 P0-A outcomes
semantic_projection.semantic_prior_for_feasibility: uniform over the five frozen atoms; this is a coverage-stress prior, not a claim about the optimal training curriculum
semantic_projection.why_uniform: Every unique and overlap support region must receive positive repeated realization opportunity so invariance is not obtained by dropping a hard/rare semantic region.

online_rejection_protocol.candidate_order: Within each source skill, consume P0-A raw records in the exact recorded source_index order. A consumed invalid or mismatched record still spends one proposer call.
online_rejection_protocol.acceptance_rule: Accept only a contract-valid record whose accepted_skill_ids projected onto {skill_003,skill_004,skill_015} exactly equals the target atom. No score, tool, text, or future record may affect acceptance.
online_rejection_protocol.source_responsibility: Unique atoms use their unique source. For overlap atoms, responsibilities alternate across the three preregistered cycles: specific source, skill_015, specific source.

decision_rule.GO: All 15 targets are accepted in schedule order using only their designated source streams before any source exceeds 24 consumed calls; all five atoms have exactly three accepted records; total consumed calls <=72.
decision_rule.STOP: At least one target cannot be realized before its designated source stream exhausts the 24 P0-A calls. This means the current quotient+shared-rejection realization is not locally feasible at the frozen budget/coverage stress test.
decision_rule.INVALID: P0-A is not GO, raw SHA does not match the P0-A result, raw shape is not exactly 72 with 24 records per source, or any contract/provenance binding is missing.

secondary_metrics_not_used_for_gate: rejection reasons: invalid contract vs wrong projected atom
next_if_go: Design the smallest faithful evolution-utility P0/C3 experiment using the same quotient definition and shared rejection backend. Do not claim downstream method superiority from P0-B alone.
next_if_stop: Stop the current SQC realization on Skill-SP; keep STRI C1/C2 and seek a different support-conditioned realization only through paper-design revision, not adaptive P0 repair.
